First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Slow group ride; no leader.
Check
Look at @criticalmasswien the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Critical Mass Wien group ride

Critical Mass Wien is a Critical Mass ride in Vienna, Austria. It rolls third Friday of the month at 5:00 pm local time from Schwarzenbergplatz.

Vienna's monthly Critical Mass, rolling since 2006. It starts at Schwarzenbergplatz on the third Friday and ends at a different place each month, sometimes with music or a film.
